title: Outlier-Robust Multi-Output Gaussian Processes
abstract: arXiv:2510.26401v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-output Gaussian process (MOGP) regression allows modelling dependencies among multiple correlated response variables. Similarly to standard Gaussian processes (GPs), MOGPs are sensitive to model misspecification and outliers, which can distort predictions within individual outputs. In the multi-output case, this situation can be further exacerbated as anomalous observations in one response can adversely influence predictions for other correlated outputs. To handle this situation, we propose R-MOGP, an MOGP that is provably robust to outliers in any individual response. Our approach preserves conjugacy, achieving robustness without sacrificing computational efficiency, and integrates naturally with sparse variational inference for scalability. Empirically, we show that R-MOGP achieves performance comparable to existing state-of-the-art robust MOGPs at a fraction of their computational costs.

translated_title: 离群值鲁棒的多输出高斯过程
translated_abstract: 多输出高斯过程（MOGP）回归能够对多个相关响应变量之间的依赖关系进行建模。与标准高斯过程（GP）类似，MOGP对模型误设和离群值较为敏感，这些离群值可能会扭曲各个输出内部的预测。在多输出的情况下，这一问题可能进一步加剧，因为某一响应中的异常观测可能会对其他相关输出的预测产生不利影响。为应对这一问题，我们提出了R-MOGP，一种对任何单个响应中的离群值均具有可证明鲁棒性的多输出高斯过程。我们的方法保持了共轭性，在不牺牲计算效率的前提下实现了鲁棒性，并可与稀疏变分推断自然结合以实现可扩展性。实验表明，R-MOGP以现有最先进鲁棒MOGP的一小部分计算成本，取得了与之相当的性能。
tldr: 本文提出R-MOGP，一种对任意单个响应中的离群值具有可证明鲁棒性的多输出高斯过程，其在保持共轭性与计算效率的同时可与稀疏变分推断结合，以远低于现有最先进方法的计算成本达到相当的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes R-MOGP, a multi-output Gaussian process that is provably robust to outliers in any individual response, preserving conjugacy and computational efficiency, integrating naturally with sparse variational inference, and achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art robust MOGPs at a fraction of their computational cost.
